name: Use Case: Activity and SSD
modt_content:
system
    name UseCaseTest

uc BuyItem
    actor Buyer
    description "Allows a buyer to purchase an item"
    pre Item.Price > 0
  
    step selectItem
    @start step enterPaymentDetails :> @sys
        - cardNumber
        - cvv

    alt [Unauthorized] goto @start
  
    step processPayment :> @sys
    @done step shipItem
  
    post Item.Stock--

rel Buyer -- BuyItem
